summary: A homeowner at the microphone says the tax bill climbed so fast that it upended a settled life.
realLife: At a town budget hearing, a homeowner who moved in a few years earlier described her yearly tax bill rising by more than half and said it broke the plans she had made. Others said the burden lands on working families and retirees, that being ignored was disrespectful, and that the tax bill made owning a home feel like a punishment.
sources: Riverhead News Review (Riverhead, New York), 'Residents push back on tax hikes in prelim 2026 town budget', Nov 11, 2025: https://riverheadnewsreview.timesreview.com/2025/11/129921/residents-push-back-on-tax-hikes-in-prelim-2026-riverhead-town-budget/
